claim: The headless bootstrap wrapper overwrites the main checkout's .claude/settings.local.json with the bare skill-overrides overlay, destroying operator keys that sync_skills.sh deliberately preserves by merging.
fix: Merge the overlay into an existing .claude/settings.local.json (jq -s '.[0] * .[1]' into a tmp file, then mv) and cp only when the file is absent, mirroring sync_skills.sh:279-285.

claim: Round cleanup passes claude-review/* branch names to remove_agent_worktrees.sh, whose only target arm accepts claude/* | claude-routines/*, so every lane/refuter/station worktree and branch is left behind.
fix: Add claude-review/* to the target case arm at cmd/worktrees/remove_agent_worktrees.sh:45 (and its reachability gate and header comment), so runCleanup's names are accepted.

claim: The casual-audience SMINE_AUTO_APPLY=decide default never fires on a launchd run: run.sh defaults to decide only when the variable is empty, but the plist template install.sh copies pins it to never.
fix: Ship SMINE_AUTO_APPLY empty (<string></string>) in routines/smine-nightly/com.smine.routine.smine-nightly.plist.template so run.sh's casual decide default fires; keep the ${SMINE_AUTO_APPLY:-never} fallback for developers.

claim: handleWelcomeBootstrap writes the multi-hour bootstrap child's output to os.TempDir()/smine-bootstrap.log and never logs the pid, while spec-5 requires a log under the routine logs dir plus a logged pid.
fix: Write the bootstrap log under the routine logs dir (~/Library/Logs/claude-routine-bootstrap.log, %LOCALAPPDATA%\claude-routine\logs\bootstrap.log on Windows) and log.Printf the spawned pid and log path as startPeek does.

claim: The new permissions kind (step 4 appends the proposal's rule to permissions.allow) is reachable from step 5 auto-apply, whose candidate set in always mode with no dimensions is every proposed entry, so allow rules can widen without a vote.
fix: In smine-apply step 5, exclude kind permissions from auto-apply candidates in every mode (hold it like ab-required, autoApplyHeld reason 'permissions-vote-required') so only an explicit + vote reaches the step-4 permissions route.

claim: The policy base is resolved from the working (branch-editable) policy's base_ref, so an agent branch can pick its own base (base_ref=HEAD or an unresolvable ref plus mode free) and neuter the gated/strict gate.
fix: Resolve the base with the default candidates (never the working base_ref), read the base policy there, re-resolve with the base policy's base_ref when set, and refuse a base_ref that resolves to HEAD or the checked-out branch.

claim: GitChangedFiles uses git diff --name-only with default rename detection, so a renamed-away declaration file reports only its new path and ruleDelta never sees the removed base-side rules.
fix: Use git diff --name-only --no-renames <base> in GitChangedFiles so a renamed-away declaration file still contributes its base-side rules to ruleDelta.

claim: The orchestrate-stage reconcile copies every repos.json path into ~/.claude/settings.json additionalDirectories with no record of whether the operator granted access, so a repo added with the grant unticked is granted on the next nightly.
fix: Persist the grant decision on the registry entry (repos.Repo.Granted, set by handleReposAdd when grantAccess) and append only entries with .granted == true in run.sh; report drift instead of granting otherwise.

claim: surfaceDelta compares raw working-tree bytes to git show blob bytes, so on a CRLF checkout (core.autocrlf=true) unchanged policy surface files are reported as changed.
fix: Decide surface differences through git (git diff --quiet <base> -- <path> plus an untracked/absent check), or normalize CRLF to LF on both sides before comparing.

claim: The diff deletes the four permissions.ask rules for Edit/Write on *.acdsl and acdsl/** from the deployed settings template; no spec asks for it and the policy guard exits 0 in free mode, so nothing replaces the confirmation.
fix: Restore the four Edit/Write acdsl ask rules in settings/claude_code/settings.json, or record the removal and its reason in the governing plan.

claim: handleProfileSave persists the new audience before taking the skills-sync lock and decides whether to sync by comparing against the stored audience, so a retry after a 409 or a failed skills.Sync skips the sync.
fix: Acquire the skills-sync lock (409 without saving) before persisting the profile, or re-run skills.Sync whenever the saved audience differs from the last successfully synced one.

claim: handleReposAdd runs git init -b main on a plain folder before the registry's duplicate-name rejection, so a rejected duplicate add still mutates the folder.
fix: In the add op, reject when s.repoRegistry.Find(name) already exists before the git-init block; Registry.Add keeps its authoritative duplicate check.

claim: The literal route GET /sessions/archive shadows GET /sessions/{scope} for a mining folder named 'archive', which neither Repo.Validate nor sessions.validateScopeName reserves.
fix: Reserve 'archive' in Repo.Validate and sessions.validateScopeName, or move the archive tab to a path outside the /sessions/{scope} namespace.

claim: Repo.Validate caps Label with len(r.Label), a byte count, while the form's maxlength and error text count characters, so an 80-character label with umlauts is rejected.
fix: Compare utf8.RuneCountInString(r.Label) > labelMaxLength instead of len(r.Label).

claim: install.ps1 treats a missing shellcheck as a hard prerequisite (appended to $missing, which throws without winget or when declined) instead of the non-fatal warning correctness-127 requires.
fix: Replace the $missing append for shellcheck with a non-fatal Write-Warning carrying the `winget install koalaman.shellcheck` hint, as install.sh:58-60 does.

claim: The Trim stage enforcing --max-proposals-mined counts and trims only proposals/{routines,context,skills}.json although smine-permissions is now a proposal dimension writing proposals/permissions.json, so the global cap is exceeded.
fix: Derive the Trim prompt's kind list from PROPOSAL_DIMENSIONS (at minimum add permissions.json) so proposals/{routines,context,skills,permissions}.json are all counted and trimmed.

claim: smine-batch applies --last on top of --since instead of letting --since win, and session-mine.js forwards both flags, so /smine --since D --last n mines only n sessions.
fix: State in smine-batch Args/Select that --last is ignored when --since is given, and in session-mine.js emit --last only when since is empty.

claim: The session-mine workflow never forwards --repos to smine-batch: its args contract and mineArgs omit repos, though --repos is smine-batch's only folder-routing input.
fix: Add repos to the session-mine.js args contract and mineArgs (`--repos ${repos}`), and to the Workflow args list in smine/SKILL.md §1/§2.

claim: config-ui-fidelity-gate.js declares it is invoked by /fimplement before the first commit and the fimplement changelog promises it, but no skill invokes it, so the gate never runs.
fix: Add a fimplement Phase 3 step that invokes the gate via Workflow scriptPath on config-server template/CSS diffs and blocks the commit on gate.pass=false, or remove the workflow and its changelog promise.

claim: foreign-toolchain-pretag.js says /package-commit invokes it before a release tag and the changelog promises a blocking pre-tag compile, but package-commit has no tag step and never invokes it.
fix: Wire the pretag gate into the skill step that owns release tagging via Workflow scriptPath, failing on gate.pass=false, or drop the workflow and its changelog claim.

claim: The skill-eval routine's new fexplore defaults point ROUTINE_EVAL_QUALITY_CONTEXT at plans/archived/applied_probe_safety/design/exploration.md, which exists in no ref; the fexplore brief's concept path is equally absent.
fix: Commit the applied_probe_safety concept/exploration at a tracked path (the archive moved to plans/v1-2-1) and repoint the brief and ROUTINE_EVAL_QUALITY_CONTEXT, or revert the skill-eval defaults.

claim: routines/README.md documents a skill-eval-fexplore routine (table row, kickstart recipe) whose directory commit 1575690 deleted; the row also splits the table with a blank line.
fix: Remove the skill-eval-fexplore routine row and its paragraph, and drop the blank line splitting the table.

claim: The new build-install target's help line is labeled '## build:', so make help prints build twice and never lists build-install.
fix: Change Makefile:81 to `## build-install: build all binaries and install`.

claim: subsystem-grounding.js declares /fdesign invokes it for multi-subsystem drivers, but fdesign SKILL.md never names it, so the workflow is unreachable.
fix: Add an fdesign Ground step invoking subsystem-grounding.js via Workflow scriptPath for drivers spanning two or more subsystems, or remove the workflow.

claim: After smine-permissions became a fifth dimension, the dimension lists at smine SKILL.md L20, L33, L49 and smine-batch SKILL.md L104 still name only four.
fix: Add permissions to the dimension lists at smine SKILL.md L20, L33, L49 and smine-batch SKILL.md L104.

claim: The rootCause doc comment now sits above func worktreeSessions, leaving rootCause undocumented and worktreeSessions with a misleading doc.
fix: Move the rootCause doc comment (174-175) back directly above func rootCause and leave worktreeSessions with only its own comment.

claim: Profile parsing/dev-mode resolution, skill-overlay copy and repos-roster logic are duplicated between cmd/bootstrap/run.sh and routines/smine-nightly/run.sh.
fix: Extract profile parsing and dev-mode resolution, the skill-overlay step and the repos roster into a shared routines/_lib helper sourced by both cmd/bootstrap/run.sh and routines/smine-nightly/run.sh.

claim: ruleDelta reads the working side of changed declaration files from disk while acdsl check loads rules only from FileUniverse; `git rm --cached acdsl/rules.acdsl` plus a .git/info/exclude entry disables every central rule while CheckPolicy reports zero removed rules in a gated/strict repo.

claim: GitChangedFiles tokenizes git diff --name-only / ls-files --others output with strings.Fields and without -z, so a declaration file whose path has a space or non-ASCII byte never reaches ruleDelta under its real name and contributes no rules on either side; gated/strict branches can change protected rules in such a file unreported.
fix: Use `git diff --name-only -z <base>` and `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z`, split on NUL instead of strings.Fields, so paths reach ruleDelta verbatim.

claim: policyBase recognizes the base branch only by stripping a literal "origin/" prefix, so with base_ref "upstream/main" or "refs/heads/main" a human on the base branch itself is treated as a boundary and uncommitted surface changes on main are flagged, contradicting correctness-71.
